news.title: Department of Energy award will support KU research to develop new computational framework for improving simulations
news.summary_en: Cheng Huang, assistant professor of aerospace engineering at the University of Kansas, has won a five-year, $875,000 grant from the U.S. Department of Energy through the DOE’s Office of Science Early Career Research Program.

news.title: Ashley Shew to discuss techno-ableism at biannual Hall Center in Wichita event
news.summary_en: The Hall Center for the Humanities will host its biannual Hall Center in Wichita event Nov. 9 at the Wichita Art Museum. Virginia Tech researcher Ashley Shew will present “Walkie Talkies & Other Technoableist Dreams.”

news.title: KU Lawrence campus events to honor military service around Veterans Day
news.summary_en: Observances recognize veterans, active-duty service members, National Guard and Reserve members, military-affiliated students and military families whose service and sacrifice have strengthened the university, the state of Kansas and the nation.

news.title: Spencer Lecture to feature ‘Dark Laboratory’ author Tao Leigh Goffe
news.summary_en: The Commons at the University of Kansas will welcome author and interdisciplinary artist Tao Leigh Goffe to present the annual Kenneth Spencer Lecture. The event will take place at 7 p.m. Nov. 9 at Liberty Hall in downtown Lawrence.

news.title: Comparative law scholar to discuss corporate law, governance
news.summary_en: Afra Afsharipour will present “Comparative Corporate Governance and the Pathology of Controlling Shareholder Power” at 3:45 p.m. Nov. 12 in 107 Green Hall. The public is invited to attend the free lecture and reception to follow. Registration is requested.

news.title: Humanlike design of AI voice assistants helps users disregard security risks, study finds
news.summary_en: New research from Andrew Chen, Ronald G. Harper Professor at the University of Kansas School of Business, finds that humanlike voice qualities significantly increase perceived enjoyment of artificial intelligence-based voice assistants, which in turn reduces both perceived security risk and user intention to discontinue using the tool.

news.title: Study finds Amazon rainforest now releases more carbon than it absorbs
news.summary_en: A new study in Nature by an international team of researchers, including from the University of Kansas, shows the hotter, drier Amazon is a net source of global carbon emissions.

news.title: KU Alumni announces student honorees of 2026 Homecoming awards
news.summary_en: The 114th University of Kansas Homecoming, sponsored by Central Bank, concluded with a win against Baylor University on Oct. 24. Thirteen Jayhawks were honored with 2026 Homecoming Awards, shining a spotlight on the alumni, students and faculty who embody the very best of Jayhawk pride and tradition.
